violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the prep/packaging area was lacking paper towels. PIC refilled. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

Molluscan Shellfish (steamers) located in the walk-in cooler did not have the proper identification tags. Molluscan Shellstock tags must remain attached to the container in which the Molluscan Shellstock are received until the container is empty. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026
The retail shellstock area must contain a consumer advisory statement. Inspector provided sign. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

Inspector observed various food items in the retail area with incomplete labeling. PIC moved items aware from customer self service areas. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients (including allergens), the quantity of the contents, and the business name and address. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026
Various items were observed stored on the floor in the basement walk-in freezer. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/18/2024

The serving utensils and knife are stored on an unclean surface (cardboard and between 3 bay sink and wall). During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

The cutting boards in the seafood prep are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

The condensate from the retail freezers, ice bins, and seafood display units are draining into containers. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/25/2024

Inspector observed water dripping from above in the basement area (pipes, ceiling, and condensate from walk-in cooler/freezer pipes) with buckets catching water. Staff informed not to store food items under drips. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026

The walk-in cooler fan cover was observed with debris. The floors in the basement area has puddles of water. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the basement area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2025
The hand-washing sink in the prep/packaging area was lacking paper towels. PIC replaced. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026

Inspector observed ROP frozen cooked lobster without proper labeling. Per interview with PIC, establishment receives item from Ferry Wharf Fish Market. Per RIDOH-CFP, establishment does not have HACCP plan for ROPing cooked lobster. Items were embargoed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026

Seaweed salad was observed sold outside of original packaging and did not contain labels. PIC made label for items. Seafood stuffing from Ferry Wharf Fish Market was lacking complete label (undeclared allergens and lacks subingredients, manufacture information, and net weight). Item was embargoed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026
Frozen items were observed stored on the floor in the basement walk-in freezer. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/18/2024

The utensils (tongs and spoons) are stored on an unclean surface (rack inside display coolers) between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026

The cutting boards in the seafood prep area are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

The condensate from the retail chest freezers, ice bins, and seafood display cooler unit are draining into containers. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/25/2024

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the basement area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2025

The walk-in cooler fan cover has an accumulation of soil residue. The basement and seafood department floors were observed with puddles. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026
